acceptanceRules: Run both files without a title filter. Every enumerated matrix case must be collected, executed and passed; the complete file census must equal requiredCensus, with zero skipped/todo and childSubstituted=0. File-level green alone is insufficient.
Compare all three exact source/test fingerprints before reuse and after execution; use canonical clean as-committed receipts for final proof.
A filtered fixture run proves only selected cases, never the other collected-but-skipped cases.

Each mutation needs same-invocation passing baseline and passing copy baseline, then a caught mutant. Compare subject and test identities and canonical binding refs. Never pipe the mutation test command.
Missing/unreadable/unresolved evidence is UNKNOWN; observed failure, omission, skipped required case or identity mismatch is BROKEN.

An approved amendment may retire scored R5 only after folding every run/case/source/mutation obligation into R1-R4 verification and explicitly disposing both historical R5 auto clauses. No verification obligation is waived.
